title: Live and Get Pie
author: Stewart C Baker (as 'Tame Spond/ee')
genres: A masterwork in verse—I COULD have made it worse
description:
A deeply important philosophical masterwork of serious electronic literature

The cake may be a lie, but what about the pie?
Also you're a spy who's falling from the sky.
Your mission is unknown before here you were flown.
Alas! Alack! Aday! Most verbs have gone away.
Frankly I'm surprised this runs, as it's comprised
of many foolish jokes. I swear, it is no hoax
when unto you I say, I wrote this in a day.
There will be bugs, okay?

Content warning: heights, gun violence
